The structure of composition H₂N₂O₄ (reduced formula HNO₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral nitrogen centers coordinated by four oxygen neighbors, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between N-centered tetrahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between H-centered 3-vertex polyhedra and N-centered tetrahedra.
